title: Inter Without Çalhanoğlu for Stuttgart, Sportmediaset Reports | Nerazzurri Daily
description:
Inter don’t need Çalhanoğlu to beat Stuttgart — Sportmediaset reports he misses Wednesday’s game.
Free daily digest in English: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=84

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

REPORTED — Çalhanoğlu will miss Stuttgart and both Genoa games, in Serie A and the Coppa Italia; he hurt the back of his right thigh in Bergamo, has tests today and could be out at least three weeks. Zieliński is unlikely to play; Stanković is the natural replacement (Sportmediaset, Nov 24).
CONFIRMED — François Letexier of France referees Inter vs Stuttgart. Inter are 15th in the Champions League table with six points, one behind Stuttgart (Inter.it, Nov 23).
CONFIRMED — Chivu’s pre-match press conference is today at 8:30 AM ET, 14:30 CET (Inter.it, Nov 23).
REPORTED — Çalhanoğlu’s contract runs to June 2027; his agent wants about €6.5 million a year for two more years (Tuttosport, Nov 22).
NEXT — Inter vs VfB Stuttgart, Wed, Nov 25, 3:00 PM ET, 21:00 CET, Champions League matchday 5. US TV: Paramount+.
